# Vice President of the Government

Deputy Prime Minister
| first           = Alexandre Barro Chambrier
| formation       = 5 May 2025
}}
The Vice President of the Government () is a political position in Gabon, which was created on 5 May 2025, it establishment was already planned in October 2024. The President appoints the Vice President of the Government. The first holder of the office was Alexandre Barro Chambrier.
